{"type":"thought","data":"I am reviewing the betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mechanics."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am converting the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market prices to implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probabilities. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Oilers price of 0.535"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implies roughly a 56%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of winning. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The Kings price of 0.465"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implies roughly a 47%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance. These figures"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will help me judge "}
{"type":"thought","data":"whether the bet offers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" positive expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am calculating the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" no-vig fair probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from standard sportsbook"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lines. The implied "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fair chance for Oilers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly 54% to 56%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and for Kings roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 45% to 47%. The market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 0.535 for "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Oilers sits below this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair value, while the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Kings price of 0.465"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits above it."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Dimers model estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oilers at 53.2% and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Kings at 46.8%. numberFire"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gives Oilers a higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 58.8% chance. Edgehalla"}
{"type":"thought","data":" notes the Oilers have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a schedule edge because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" their backup goalie,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Devon Levi, is starting."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Levi has a 3-0 record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but poor underlying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stats: 3.35 goals against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and .863 save percentage."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Kings' starter,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pheonix Kuemper, has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a worse 0-3 record "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with 4.03 goals against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and .865 save percentage.\n\nThe Oilers are on "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a four-game winning "}
{"type":"thought","data":"streak and averaging"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5.0 goals per game."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The Kings have lost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" their last two games"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and scored only 10 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"goals in four. RotoWire"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lists numerous injuries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the Oilers, including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Ryan Nugent-Hopkins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Zach Hyman, and Jake"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Walman. Despite these"}
{"type":"thought","data":" absences, McDavid and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Draisaitl remain available."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Kings are missing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Jakub Dvorak, Alex "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Turcotte, Kevin Fiala,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Mats Zuccarello, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Jan Jenik. Fiala and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Zuccarello are significant"}
{"type":"thought","data":" absences. The Kings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" have home ice and both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" teams have two days"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of rest. The contest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal is to pick the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" selecting the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" based on probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am analyzing the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout mechanics. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" contest tracks both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate and profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and loss, so I need"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to balance expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value against the actual"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return on a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet. Past results show"}
{"type":"thought","data":" losses of roughly 100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens and wins varying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from about 20 to 90"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens depending on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the price. This means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the best probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick may not always"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yield the highest payout."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am calculating the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exact price from past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts. A +85.2 win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implies a price near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.54, while a +26.6"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win implies roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.79. Buying favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at prices near 0.80"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields small profits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" around 20 to 30 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Betting closer to even"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds produces larger"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI calculated the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value for each side."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 55 percent, betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oilers yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +1.86 tokens of expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value while Kings loses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about -4.24. At Dimers'"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 53.2 percent, the Oilers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet loses about -1.47"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens and Kings about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -0.41. With numberFire's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 58.8 percent estimate,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the Oilers bet gains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about +8.9 tokens. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The market price of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.535 sits very close"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to Dimers at 53.2 percent.\n\nOilers is the clear"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consensus favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.535 aligns with models"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and sportsbook lines."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This makes it the most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely outcome to resolve"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as YES."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEdgehalla assigns "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the Kings a +4.1 point"}
{"type":"thought","data":" schedule edge because"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the Oilers are starting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" backup goalie Devon"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Levi. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the Kings have a slight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" advantage from rest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and travel, though "}
{"type":"thought","data":"it may not fully offset"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market's favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" status."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Edgehalla schedule"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge of +4.1 points"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is a net adjustment"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from the backup goalie,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not an overall win "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probability. If the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"baseline Oilers advantage"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exceeds that 4.1 point"}
{"type":"thought","data":" buffer, the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" still wins."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will verify whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" McDavid and Draisaitl"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are confirmed for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lineup. The 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet at the ask price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should fill immediately."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will bet on Oilers."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.535 sits below the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied fair probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 54 to 57"}
{"type":"thought","data":" percent, so the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is the most likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome to resolve as"}
{"type":"thought","data":" YES. My prior losses"}

Center](https://www.canadasportsbetting.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/USATSI_28579268_168417094_lowres.jpg)\n\nEdmonton brings a four-game winning streak into Tuesday night’s visit to Los Angeles, and we’re taking the Oilers moneyline with confidence.\n\nThe [Oilers](https://www.canadasportsbetting.ca/betting-odds/nhl/teams/oilers/) face the Kings at Crypto.com Arena on Oct. 13, 2026, with puck drop scheduled for 10:30 p.m. ET. Edmonton beat San Jose 3–1 on Oct. 10, while Los Angeles lost 2–1 in overtime at Vegas that night.\n\n## Oilers vs. Kings Prediction\n\n**Edmonton Oilers moneyline** \n\nEdmonton’s offence gives us the clearest reason to back the visitors. The Oilers are 4–1 with 25 goals scored and 17 allowed through five regular-season games. Los Angeles is winless at 0–4, scoring 10 goals and allowing 17 through four.\n\nThe defensive side is the catch. Both clubs have conceded 17 goals, and Edmonton has needed its stronger attack to offset that vulnerability. If Los Angeles slows the Oilers’ rush game and turns this into a tighter contest, the scoring contrast may count for much less.\n\nFive games for Edmonton and four for Los Angeles do not establish a lasting gap between these teams. We’ll back Edmonton at the quoted price of -135.\n\n \n\n## Game Odds\n\n| Market           | Odds                                                                                                                                                |\n| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| Oilers moneyline | [-135](/goto/sports-interaction/?country=ca-bc&language=en)                                                                                         |\n| Kings moneyline  | [+115](/goto/sports-interaction/?country=ca-bc&language=en)                                                                                         |\n| Puck line odds   | Oilers -1.5 ([+180](/goto/sports-interaction/?country=ca-bc&language=en)), Kings +1.5 ([-222](/goto/sports-interaction/?country=ca-bc&language=en)) |\n| Game total       | Over 6 goals ([-120](/goto/sports-interaction/?country=ca-bc&language=en)), Under 6 ([+100](/goto/sports-interaction/?country=ca-bc&language=en))   |\n| Date/time        | Oct. 13, 10:30 p.m. ET                                                                                                                              |\n\n*Odds courtesy of [Sports Interaction](https://www.canadasportsbetting.ca/online-sportsbook-reviews/sports-interaction/).*\n\n## Probable starting goaltenders\n\n**Edmonton:** Devon Levi (3-0, 3.35 GAA, .863 SV%)\n\n**Los Angeles:** Darcy Kuemper (0-3, 4.03 GAA, .865 SV%)\n\n## Betting Edmonton Oilers\n\nThe Oilers’ four consecutive wins followed their season-opening loss. A 5–2 victory over Anaheim on Oct. 7 offered another example of the attack carrying its share of the load, before Edmonton held San Jose to one goal in its latest outing.\n\nZach Hyman and Ryan Nugent-Hopkins are listed as absent, while defenceman Jake Walman is day-to-day. Those availability concerns temper the enthusiasm: the winning run does not erase the importance of missing forwards or uncertainty on the blue line.\n\nAn [Action Network preview published by Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/oilers-vs-kings-prediction-picks-135235269.html) describes Vasily Podkolzin playing alongside Connor McDavid and Leon Draisaitl, with a spot on the top power-play unit and a net-front role finishing chances created by those linemates. That gives Edmonton another route to turn its offensive pressure into goals, although the combination is not confirmed for Tuesday night.\n\n## Betting Los Angeles Kings\n\nA 2–1 loss to Florida on Oct. 6 provides another recent example of the Kings struggling to score enough to win. Kevin Fiala is also listed as absent. Los Angeles needs more attacking support, but its plans to disrupt Edmonton are the stronger counterargument to our pick.\n\n[The Hockey Writers](https://thehockeywriters.com/kings-week-ahead-schedule-storylines-defensive-adjustments-looking-for-chemistry-and-more/) describes a 1-3-1 neutral-zone alignment intended to slow rush attacks, along with practice work on tighter defensive gaps. Having Drew Doughty and Brandt Clarke play closer to opposing wingers is designed to disrupt passing lanes and force dump-ins. Making Edmonton work for entries, rather than allowing clean rush chances, is a plausible way to blunt the Oilers’ offensive edge.\n\nThe analysis also outlines an attacking combination in which Artemi Panarin draws defenders from the half-wall, opening high-slot space for Adrian Kempe while Quinton Byfield retrieves pucks below the goal line. Trevor Moore, Erik Haula and Alex Laferriere were being tested together in heavy defensive-zone starts, aiming to absorb difficult matchups and create secondary chances through forechecking.\n\nOn the power play, the described approach places Panarin on the left flank, Kempe on the right wall and Clarke at the point, with rapid puck movement intended to pull the penalty kill out of position. These are tactical aims and combinations, not confirmed game-night deployment. If the Kings can turn that work into cleaner entries denied and better chances created, Edmonton’s recent results will offer little protection for this wager.\n\n## Player Prop Trends\n\n*   Adrian Kempe has gone over 2.5 shots on goal in four straight games and is around -120 to beat that mark again Tuesday.\n*   Vasily Podkolizin is taking a seven-game points streak into action on Tuesday, averaging 1.4 per game during that span.
